citations.quote: TotalEnergies SE said Friday it will propose the renewal of Patrick Pouyanne's mandate as chair and chief executive when shareholders meet May 2027.
citations.title: TotalEnergies Backs Pouyanne to Remain Chair and CEO

sentences.quote: decided unanimously and with conviction to continue to combine positions of chairman and chief executive officer
sentences.text: On September 25, 2026 the board said it will propose renewing Patrick Pouyanne's mandate as chairman and chief executive at the May 2027 shareholders' meeting, deciding unanimously to keep the chairman and CEO roles combined alongside a lead independent director, with Jacques Aschenbroich also proposed for renewal as lead independent director; the board tied this to the strategy built on two pillars, Oil and Gas and Integrated Power.

Effective September 1, 2026, Emmanuelle Guegan, previously Senior Vice President Corporate Affairs of Exploration and Production, became President Marketing and Services and joined the Executive Committee as Bernard Pinatel retired.
